image_ref.description: Sandbox reference to image, image sequence, or PDF. PDFs are rasterized internally at the configured DPI via PyMuPDF. Multi-page sequences accepted as ordered array of refs joined by '|' OR as a single PDF path.

mode.description: Processing mode per the upstream model card. 'gundam' = 640x640 patches (faster, lower memory). 'base' = 1024x1024 patches (higher fidelity, more compute).

max_pages.description: Hard ceiling on pages processed in one inference call. Inputs above this are rejected; chunk caller-side.

pdf_dpi.description: Rasterization DPI when the input is a PDF.

no_repeat_ngram_size.description: n-gram repeat avoidance parameter from the upstream model card. Higher values reduce repetition risk on long documents.

text.description: Full extracted text across all pages. Multi-page outputs include '\n--- page N ---\n' separators between page texts.

pages.description: Per-page text array. Present for multi-page inputs (PDF or sequence).

engine.description: Engine identity + revision for receipt citation, e.g. 'baidu-unlimited-ocr-3b@safetensors-bf16-2026-06'.

context_tokens_used.description: Model context tokens consumed by this inference. Upstream model card declares 32768 as the hard maximum.

mode_used.description: Echo of the processing mode applied. Useful for downstream comparison against the requested mode.

summary: Long-horizon multi-page OCR via Baidu Unlimited-OCR 3B, with native PDF rasterization and 32K-token document context.
